# Welcome to my first post

## A little about this blog

Hi! My name is Mia and I am super excited to be taking this class! I am incredibly fascinated by the intersection of diplomacy and technology, as I see the next wave of global issues and conflict to be driven by byproducts of STEM. I think it is important for peacemakers to be able to accurately communicate with analysts and have some semblance of coding/biology/ecology, as climate change, artificial intelligence, and energy press as major global issues of today. That is why I am taking this course. 

Upon reflection, I have learned SO MUCH in this class. I am so grateful to have had experience in RStudio so that these platforms are not foreign to me. I have already been able to help my peers just simply because I understand that you need to install.packages the first time you use soemthign new! Coding can be really intimidating, and I am glad I took this class and asked the dumb questions. Even though my grade is lower than I would want, I know I will use this information for years to come. Especially in my reserach fellowship this summer! Here is a link if you're interested [NextGenPop Research Scholars](https://nextgenpop.org)

_Also I would like to note I did attend tutoring on Monday, May 4th with Caroline K to recieve some extra help and get another set of eyes on my blog. We tried to go through feedback I recieved on my graded blogs and organize files. Just wanted to let you know!_
